scope: Private selected-file transport; not wired to default downloads or public acquisition
evidence_policy: Fresh candidate-bound checks and actual separate-invocation review govern completion. This report supplies no executed or parent pass.
controls: Validated source, finite request/deadline/payload budgets and trusted exact origins are copied before work. Default origin is Hugging Face only; redirect data cannot grant another origin. No public field or operation grants authority.

Every hop requires public-only DNS and pinned TCP with canonical Host/SNI and default certificate verification. No ambient token, cookie, proxy, global client mutation, hidden retry or SDK/Xet fallback is used.

Immutable reads are at most64KiB and bounded by the remaining selected/aggregate payload allowance plus one nonpublished EOF byte. Sink entry is fenced and bounded. Exact EOF/hash precedes a numeric/SHA256 receipt; staging/publication remain caller-owned.

One-use failed sessions cannot retry. A single file lease stays owned through writer/socket settlement. Timed-out DNS retains its sole nonqueueing slot. Unconfirmed close retains the exact known connection and lease without a recovery grant.

Policy fences recheck cancellation/failure/deadline after the callback. Independent socket custody survives stdlib Connection:close detachment; explicit TLS handshake starts only after ownership capture. Deadline/cancel uses that socket through response settlement.
controlled_observations: Fourteen focused cases pass for selected URI/body bytes into a real temporary sink, exact delegated origin/default denial, unsafe redirects/framing, strict policies, one-use/oversize/short/hash refusal, chunk and aggregate budgets, cancellation, stalled writer custody, nonqueueing DNS and unconfirmed close.

The real stdlib HTTPResponse and an owned local socketpair reproduce connection.sock becomingNone while the body remains live. The one-second deadline aborts that detached body instead of waiting for its earlier five-second timeout. No external TLS/provider was exercised.

A separate constructor fixture checks actual pinned-address and default-certificate/SNI/explicit-handshake calls with controlled sockets. This is protocol evidence, not a successful certificate handshake.
retained_corrections: Independent preflight found that a held currentness callback could returnTrue after cancellation/deadline and enter the final sink. The fence now rechecks its local lifetime after the callback; causal final-prewrite cancel/deadline cases prove zero sink entry.

Preflight found stdlib getresponse detaching Connection:close sockets before body completion. Independent exact socket custody, remaining-time reads and the real response/socketpair regression repair that lifetime gap. Earlier BytesIO-only fixtures did not prove it.
qualification_limits: No actual HF/provider transfer, real certificate handshake, model weight/load, native process/lifetime or parent qualification is claimed. Existing model accuracy remains closed and was not rerun.

Payload limits are not wire/header-overhead quotas. Native-uninterruptible DNS, writer and close operations retain custody and may settle after the outward deadline; no hard completion-time claim is made.

The private transport owns no staging paths or publication. Current caller/effect authorization, owned staging, disk accounting, approved exact delegate origins, integration and real outcomes remain I7 work.
No arbitrary CDN/wildcard authority, private credential support or production fallback is introduced. Ordinary SDK downloads and existing guards are unchanged.
